$description: Provisional code names for the Figma semantic colour tokens. This file is the single place to rename: keys are Figma names (property/group/role), values the name used in code (class = name with / replaced by -, CSS variable = --guk-<class>). Several Figma names may map to one code name only when their Light and Dark values are identical (the generator checks). Every Figma name not listed keeps its name. `additions` are code-only tokens that Figma does not define as semantic variables yet. An addition either has its own `light`/`dark` values or is an `alias` of another token (same value in every theme).

ring/accent/focus.note: Figma Button Focus state binds its ring (4px drop shadow) to the primitive aragon/400, not to a semantic variable.

ring/success/focus.note: Figma Button Focus state binds its ring to the primitive green/400.

ring/warning/focus.note: Figma Button Focus state binds its ring to the primitive orange/400.

ring/critical/focus.note: Figma Button Focus state binds its ring to the primitive red/400.

border/accent/fill.note: Code-only, pending design review: the Button draws a 1px border in its fill colour (Figma has no stroke there). A transparent border is not pixel-identical at the rounded corners, so the border follows the fill token.

border/accent/fill-hover.note: Code-only, pending design review: the Button draws a 1px border in its fill colour (Figma has no stroke there). A transparent border is not pixel-identical at the rounded corners, so the border follows the fill token.

shadow/surface/md.note: Code-only, pending design review: Figma defines shadow sm, default and 2xl only. The md elevation (shadow-neutral-md) recurs on raised surfaces: dialog and alert-dialog panels, the neutral tooltip and the asset-transfer address panel on hover (5 uses). Light/Dark reuse the Figma shadow/surface/default colour (same 10% alpha as today's md shadow).

shadow/accent/md.note: Code-only, pending design review: the hover elevation of a selected selectable card (shadow-primary-md on CheckboxCard and RadioCard, 2 uses). Light/Dark reuse the Figma shadow/accent/default colour (same 10% alpha as today's md shadow).
